reason: I'd use the free visit and probably come back once on a rainy Saturday, because indoor options for a toddler here are limited. But I work full time so it's weekends only, and I won't be buying a membership.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee. Paying $16 on a Saturday for a coffee I won't finish feels steep when the library storytime is free.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price closer to $10, or a pack that works out cheaper per visit and lets me use it on Saturdays only.
